note: CADENCED SESSIONS ONLY. Everything else A9 renders (decisions owed, monitoring coming due, cron cadences) is computed LIVE from docs/claude/work/PIPELINE.jsonl and .github/workflows/*.yml -- never duplicated here. This file exists because the daily sync and the three project-level reviews have NO machine-readable cadence record anywhere else in the repo: they are declared in CLAUDE.md / skill prose, not in a data file. That absence is itself a finding about the instruction set, not license for a general-purpose register -- see docs/claude/work/MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json item A9. Read by scripts/ops/render_schedule.py, served by GET /api/bot/work/schedule.
